hubTrigger.claim: The Mermaid set a new China box-office record and the national cinema market was growing rapidly.
China's box office was growing roughly one-third annually and could overtake the U.S. market.

cases.name: 光线传媒

evidence.claim: The Mermaid exceeded RMB1.6bn box office in 6.5 days, more than 50% of the company's most recent audited annual revenue.
Exact investment share, settlement and profit-sharing economics remained undisclosed/uncertain despite the huge headline box office.

risks: headline box office not equal company profit

cases.name: 万达院线

evidence.claim: 2015 Wanda Cinema revenue RMB8.0bn +49.9%, box-office revenue RMB6.3bn +49.6%, viewers 151m +48.9%, with 292 cinemas and 2,557 screens.
Jan-Feb 2016 cumulative box-office revenue RMB1.581bn +69.6% and viewers 38.31m +81.2%; 300 cinemas and 2,617 screens by Feb-end.

risks: cinema industry valuation may already be high

comparisonPurpose: Test whether recurring reported throughput is a higher-quality investable expression than a single blockbuster whose company profit share remains uncertain.
